content.short: Maya Protocol enables native cross-chain swaps between Cardano and other major blockchains without bridges.
content.description: Maya Protocol is a permissionless, decentralized liquidity protocol that facilitates native cross-chain swaps between Cardano and major blockchains like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Dash. By forking the battle-tested THORChain codebase, Maya allows users to trade native assets directly from their wallets without the need for wrapped tokens or centralized bridges. The protocol uses on-chain vaults to manage security and capital efficiency, empowering users to maintain true custody of their assets while enjoying the benefits of a global, multi-chain decentralized exchange ecosystem.
content.meta: Maya Protocol offers native cross-chain swaps between Cardano, Bitcoin, and Ethereum without bridges. Explore it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
